documents.title: Dentistry: early tooth loss
documents.text: 6-year-old lost several baby teeth early with roots intact. No trauma. Parents reassured.

documents.title: Metabolic panel
documents.text: Alkaline phosphatase 28 U/L, flagged low. Calcium and phosphate normal.

documents.title: Primary care: routine check
documents.text: Routine labs unremarkable. No action needed.

documents.title: Orthopedics: foot pain
documents.text: Metatarsal stress fracture without unusual activity. Treated with boot.

documents.title: Orthopedics: thigh pain
documents.text: Thigh pain for months. X-ray shows lateral femoral cortex stress fracture. Not taking bisphosphonates. Vitamin D normal.

documents.title: Bone density scan
documents.text: Lumbar spine T-score -2.1. Femoral neck T-score -1.8.

documents.title: Endocrinology: low bone density
documents.text: Low bone mass with fractures. Plan: consider bisphosphonate therapy. Alkaline phosphatase level not commented on.

documents.title: Rheumatology: joint and muscle pain
documents.text: Chronic muscle aches and joint pain. Chondrocalcinosis on knee X-ray. Inflammatory markers normal.

documents.title: Primary care: review
documents.text: Reviewing repeated low alkaline phosphatase results, which have never been addressed. Patient's daughter also lost baby teeth early. Vitamin B6 (PLP) level and genetic testing not done.
